research.name: wifitui
research.note: Terminal Wi-Fi manager for NetworkManager with gradient-colored signal strength, fuzzy filtering and QR code network sharing.

effects: signal strength percentage colored on a green-to-orange gradient
Wi-Fi share QR code rendered as text in the terminal
saved, visible and out-of-range networks in one list, dimmed with last-connected age
